Metadata.Title: IV Bagging
Metadata.Description: Your modus operandi is becoming apparent to the authorities. Despite your flawless work, it will be increasingly difficult for you to continue. Be it as an unknown, new employee infiltrating the building and then disappearing, or leaving naked bodies behind. How about classical infiltration? Or if you really need different clothes, body bags are less noticable if the body is naked inside.Of course, all approaches open to you as long as you fulfill the mission as described.Created by: UrbenCurated by: In4Fun

Metadata.Title: Hell For Helen
Metadata.Description: Helen has been driving up the competition on the muffin market and it's time for her to retire her business.But simply killing her won't do much for our client. He wants to see her hurting, like he has been ever since she opened her business.Created by: PigieroCurated by: In4Fun

Metadata.Title: Apocalypse Class Clash
Metadata.Description: Look at them down there.The long-standing squabble between Ark Members and Architects has been reignited like the effigy. As they prepare for society to collapse, they cannot help but challenge the balance between the sections of the institution.Ridiculous. Make sure their world ends tonight.Created by: In4FunCurated by: In4Fun

Metadata.Title: Act of God
Metadata.Description: You have been tasked to eliminate these targets in the shortest time possible by the leader of a religious cult that looks to discredit all other religions. To add to the distress this will cause the Church, make sure they cannot explain the events taking place on this judgmental day.An act of God, if you will...Created by: PigieroCurated by: In4Fun

ICA agents will collect and relocate the bodies to be found after the mission.Good luck agent.

Metadata.Title: Time Trial: New York
Metadata.Description: In this trial you must make it from the front entrance to the secret CEO passage before the timer runs out!Bronze = 2:20 SASilver = 2:05 SAGold = 1:50 SAGood luckBy: Kevin Rudd

Metadata.Title: Trolley Solution
Metadata.Description: Do you know the Trolley Problem?A train, unable to break, speeds along a track, threatening to kill three people. You are able to switch to a track with only one person on it. So you could save three but actively kill one who was not in danger in the first place.Luckily, you are a killer. It is not your concern to save lives or act quickly.Or is it?By: UrbenCurated by: Kevin Rudd

Metadata.Title: Lose Yourself
Metadata.Description: If you only had one bomb, one opportunityWould you capture it, or just let it slip?Do not miss your chance to blowP.S. The bomb is in your inventoryBy: Kevin Rudd

Metadata.Title: The Red Menace Mk II
Metadata.Description: 47,Our client is a wealthy philanthropist who has decided it's time a serial pest was taken care of once and for all. Your target is a globe-trotting miscreant who has to his name over a million counts of breaking and entering, tresspassing, harassment and intimidation charges, not to mention the allegations of slave labour being levelled against him.He's evaded authorities for almost a century, but if someone's up to the task it's you.I shall leave you to prepareBy: Kevin Rudd

Metadata.Title: Captain Jack Magpie
Metadata.Description: Oh where have the waves carried me? What splendidly rich people! So much glittering, shining booty!But, what is this? Mechanical eyes? Keys like shards? Cannons that fit in pockets?That can only mean that there must be particularly valuable treasure hidden away! I wouldn’t mind if they are not only shiny but also deadly!By: UrbenCurated by: Kevin Rudd
